label: V2_2_I
code_lines: ﻿/*TABLA DE DATOS CON DIFERENCIAS EN EL INSTRUMENTO EN CADA CUENTA INVOLUCRADA */
WHERE (C_SCN_N1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada" AND ABS(DATO)>1 AND VERSION='DELTA');
/*CREA GRÁFICO RESUMEN DE CAMBIOS POR CUENTA*/
SELECT PERIODO, DATO, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN_n1,N_SCN_n1
FROM COMPARA_SC as T WHERE (C_SCN_N1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada" AND ABS(DATO)>1 AND VERSION='DELTA' AND C_CUENTA<>'Bce Final');QUIT;
PATTERN1 COLOR=PURPLE;PATTERN2 COLOR=CX33CCCC;PATTERN3 COLOR=CXFFCC00;PATTERN4 COLOR=LTGRAY;PATTERN5 COLOR=CX339966;
SYMBOL1 INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=none LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CV = BLACK;
Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE; Legend1 LABEL=(J=l "Bce Final (eje der.)");
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_SC (where=(C_CUENTA="Financiera" AND C_SCN_n1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada"));
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_SC_PIBF (where=(C_CUENTA="Financiera" AND C_SCN_n1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada"));
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
SELECT PERIODO, DATO, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN_N1,N_SCN_N1,C_CAGENTE_N1
FROM COMPARA as T WHERE (C_SCN_N1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada" AND VERSION='DELTA' AND C_CUENTA='Financiera');QUIT;
PATTERN1 COLOR=PURPLE;PATTERN2 COLOR=CX33CCCC;PATTERN3 COLOR=CXFFCC00;PATTERN4 COLOR=LTGRAY;PATTERN5 COLOR=CX339966;
SYMBOL1 INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=none LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CV = BLACK;
TITLE3 "Cambios en Cuenta Financiera por contragente";
SUBGROUP=C_CAGENTE_N1 FRAME TYPE=SUM COUTLINE=SAME 	RAXIS=AXIS MAXIS=AXIS2 	LEGEND=LEGEND2;
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_sC (where=(C_CUENTA="Bce Final" AND C_SCN_N1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada"));
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_sC_PIBF (where=(C_CUENTA="Bce Final" AND C_SCN_N1="&Codigo" AND C_ENTRADA="&Entrada"));
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
